blocks.style3d: STYLE: soft stylized 3D render of a cozy miniature office, like a polished diorama in a modern management game: smooth rounded forms, soft global illumination, gentle ambient occlusion and soft contact shadows, warm interior lamp light, subtle bevels and matte materials (light oak wood, cream plaster, sage green and dusty blue fabric, brushed metal, clear glass). Stylized friendly characters with slightly large heads, soft skin shading, simple faces. Clean, calm, high readability at small size. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT flat vector. Original design, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature.
blocks.chroma: BACKGROUND: the entire background is one perfectly flat solid pure magenta color #FF00FF, edge to edge, no gradient, no texture, no floor plane, no ground shadow, no vignette, no frame. The subject is centered with generous empty margin on every side and is never cropped. Do not use magenta, pink or purple anywhere on the subject itself.
blocks.adult: AGE: the character is clearly a grown-up ADULT office professional in their late twenties to thirties: adult face with a defined jaw and cheekbones, adult neck and shoulders, adult body proportions with longer legs. NOT a child, NOT a teenager, NOT a kid.
blocks.cam: CAMERA: front three-quarter top-down view like the reference diorama: the camera is high above, looking down at about 45 degrees, straight on (NOT an isometric diagonal). DOWN = the character faces straight toward the camera (bottom of the image), the whole front visible, seen from above. UP = the character faces straight away from the camera (top of the image), back visible, face not visible. RIGHT = the character faces the right edge of the image, a side profile seen from above.
